name: CMS Analytics And Embeds
description: The measurement id and the raw head/body HTML boxes, on a screen of their own. These were always real editable data on settings.json, but the CMS settings form renders inputs for five scalar keys and round-trips the rest untouched — so adding a verification tag meant a developer and a deploy. Note the View-on-site control: this collection is declared as having no page of its own, so it reads 'This content has no page of its own' instead of offering a link. It configures every page, so there is no single page to send an editor to, and the old behaviour — a link to /siteIntegrations/site — pointed at a 404.
